body:
The DITTO Summit focuses on operational, interoperable, and user-driven digital twins that combine:



✓ Real-time observations, sensing, and monitoring systems

✓ Advanced modeling, simulation, and predictive analytics

✓ AI, Machine Learning, and data-driven intelligence

✓ Cloud, edge, and high-performance computing ecosystems

✓ Open architectures, interoperability standards, and scalable digital platforms

✓ Cross-sector applications for climate resilience, smart cities, sustainability, governance, and innovation
summary:
Building Ocean Intelligence Together
For the Blue Economy, Sustainable Development, and a Smart 21st-Century Society
